slides.title: Cover
slides.transcript: [warmly] Susu the Cat. A true story, for Yusuf. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] This is the story of our cat, and the family that grew around her.

slides.title: Oklahoma
slides.transcript: [warmly] Oklahoma. <break time="0.4s" /> Baba Hisham was studying far from home, where the winters are long and white. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] One cold day he came back carrying a small striped kitten with four white paws. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Her name was Susu.

slides.title: Two
slides.transcript: [warmly] The two of them. <break time="0.4s" /> Susu sat on his papers while he worked, and slept by his feet when the nights ran long. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Just the two of them.

slides.title: Road
slides.transcript: [warmly] The long road. <break time="0.4s" /> Then the books went into boxes, and Susu went into her soft carrier, <break time="0.3s" /> and the road went on, and on, and on. <break time="0.5s" /> [curious] Where are we going, Baba?

slides.title: California
slides.transcript: [warmly] California. <break time="0.4s" /> A new home, with a wide sunny window. <break time="0.4s" /> Susu found the warmest spot in it before the boxes were even open. <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] This will do nicely.

slides.title: Mama
slides.transcript: [warmly] Mama came. <break time="0.4s" /> Then Mama came, and the house grew warmer and fuller. <break time="0.4s" /> Susu sniffed her hand once, thought about it, and decided she was family. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Now we are three.

slides.title: Yusuf
slides.transcript: [warmly] And then Yusuf. <break time="0.4s" /> Then a very small baby came home. <break time="0.4s" /> [gently] Susu crept close, sniffed his toes, and lay down near him to keep watch. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Now we are four.

slides.title: Days
slides.transcript: [warmly] Susu's days. <break time="0.4s" /> The sunny window in the morning. <break time="0.3s" /> Baba's lap in the evening. <break time="0.3s" /> Mama's kitchen whenever something smells good. <break time="0.3s" /> And a baby to watch over, all day long. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] A very happy cat.

slides.title: Kindness
slides.transcript: [gently] Be kind to cats. <break time="0.5s" /> Our Prophet, peace be upon him, taught us to be gentle with every animal. <break time="0.5s" /> He told of a woman who shut a cat away, and gave her no food and no water, and would not let her go and find food for herself. <break time="0.4s" /> And it counted against her. <break time="0.6s" /> [warmly] So Susu's bowls are never empty.

slides.title: Goodnight
slides.transcript: [softly] Goodnight, Susu. <break time="0.5s" /> Goodnight Baba. <break time="0.4s" /> Goodnight Mama. <break time="0.4s" /> Goodnight Susu, curled up at the end of the bed. <break time="0.6s" /> [whispers] Goodnight, Yusuf.
